property_summary: For any target address with a fallback that reverts, the reference contract C using low-level call will NOT revert and will forward the ETH (reducing C's balance), whereas the mutant using transfer will revert (preventing balance change); thus for all admissible amounts and a reverter helper, calling sendMoney never reverts on the reference and decreases C.balance by the sent amount, but the mutant can revert and keep C.balance unchanged.
change_summary: Replace low-level call with a transfer to make sendMoney revert on gas stipend/external throw, changing whether balances are forwarded and thus altering observable balance after call.
